title: Semialgebraically connected smooth intersections of two quadrics in projective five-space over real Puiseux series that are not stably rational
source_title: Variétés réelles semi-algébriquement connexes non stablement rationnelles
author: Jean-Louis Colliot-Thélène; Alena Pirutka; Federico Scavia
difficulty_reason: A standard decomposition-of-diagonal specialization theorem does not by itself cover the singular special fiber used here. The authors pass to quotients by quadratic-extension norms, prove norm-surjectivity on the singular locus and its inverse image, and transport the nonconstant unramified Brauer obstruction through a generic-point DVR to all finite Puiseux extensions. They then construct a real two-quadrics model with only four nonreal singularities and a smooth deformation, while the complete Nash-triviality argument preserves semi-algebraic connectedness of the real locus.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Theorem3.6 over R{{t}}, not over the ordinary real field: q1 and q2 are real quadratic forms whose common zero set is a smooth complete intersection in P5; the displayed deformation of a^2+b^2+c^2-cd=0 and e^2+f^2-bd=0 has a smooth generic fiber. Its real-Puiseux points form a semialgebraically connected space, but it is not universally CH0-trivial and hence is not stably rational. Full explicit construction and Lemma3.5 are on physical17. Necessary new core: the first proof of semialgebraic specialization6–8, birational connectedness Lemma1.4 on11, norm-quotient pairing and specialization12–14, and the Brauer-obstructed model15. Published Coste–Shiota Nash triviality and Artin–Lang transfer are named background. The unramified nonconstant Brauer class (-1,u) for the explicit quadric fibration is traced to the authors cited CTP24 Proposition13.1; its use in the new specialization argument is complete. Finite nonreal singular points are explicitly listed, with bounded routine construction checks. No higher-dimensional variant or ordinary-real-field assertion is selected.

historical_source_pdf_evidence.original_difficulty_reason: The authors combine semialgebraic smoothing, norm-quotient zero-cycle specialization, an unramified Brauer obstruction and an explicit degeneration to construct smooth connected real-Puiseux threefolds failing universal CH0 triviality. These local arithmetic and geometric constructions exceed ordinary qualifying examinations.
